observations: I opened assets/panels/01-2.png, workflow/review/page-01.png and main-cast.png with Read and looked at them.

Meera matches main-cast.png: round face, large round eyes, thin high brows, a side braid with a teal tie over her left shoulder (screen-right), a blue block-print kurta, and a silver bangle on her right wrist.

Her hands match production. Her left hand holds the beige corded receiver to her left ear (screen-right) and the coiled cord runs to the desk phone. Her right hand, the one with the bangle, writes in an open register with a pen. The fingers and the pen grip are clean.

A tall stack of registers sits at left and a queue of patients is seen from behind in the foreground. There is a sweat drop and small ring lines by the phone. Her expression is flustered but friendly, matching the emotion note.
The register pages are ruled but blank, the phone keypad buttons are unmarked, and the book spines are plain. There is no readable text.
On page-01.png both balloons sit in the empty upper wall. The tails end at the top of her head. Her face, both hands, the phone, the pen and the open register stay clear.
